stem.text: Two progressive sound waves move in opposite directions and superpose to form a stationary wave.
Which statement describes an antinode of this stationary wave?

A.text: a position where the phase difference between the two waves is always $0^{\circ}$

B.text: a position where the phase difference between the two waves is always $180^{\circ}$

C.text: a position where the stationary wave has maximum amplitude

D.text: a position where the stationary wave has minimum amplitude
